verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a contract-management platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Ironclad's core product. The documentation describes a cloud platform reached through APIs and webhooks. The BYOSP middleware runs on the customer side next to Ironclad, not as a self-hosted Ironclad, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
